prompts:
Create one finished premium editorial 3D illustration, SQUARE 1:1 composition, high resolution. This is an original hero art asset for a personal everyday movement journal called Bokki Plan, NOT an app screenshot and NOT an interface. NO text, letters, numbers, words, brands, logos, screens, phone frames, charts or UI anywhere.
Art direction: artful miniature architectural diorama photographed in a beautiful white studio, tactile matte porcelain, warm paper, frosted mint acrylic and deep forest green. Clean sophisticated brand colors: white #FFFFFF, warm ivory #F6F8F2, deep green #153F35, mint #91DDB6, a tiny subdued coral accent. Calm bright daylight, soft realistic shadows, premium product design magazine quality, quiet luxury, crisp refined detail, no toyish cartoon gloss.
Subject: one compact, entirely FICTIONAL walkable neighborhood as an irregular ivory raised island. A modest cream house on one side, a small elegant cafe pavilion on the other, a leafy pocket park with sculptural deep-green trees in between. A single continuous soft mint ribbon route threads through the three places with tiny rounded stepping marks and one little deep-green place pin at a stop. No real-world streets, names, recognizable landmarks, personal data or people. Show a small subtle upright triangular play token as a physical sculpture near the route to hint at replay. The route must be legible as one everyday journey.
Composition: camera at elevated three-quarter angle, entire diorama fully visible with generous white space around it, centered and slightly diagonal from bottom left to top right. Objects occupy about 80% of square, minimal coherent scene, purposeful arrangement, nothing cut off. Background seamlessly pure white. Make an exquisite final illustration with no surrounding copy or labels.

Create one finished premium editorial 3D illustration, SQUARE 1:1 composition, high resolution. This is an original hero art asset for Bokki Plan about health context and notes tied to time and place, NOT an app screenshot and NOT an interface. NO text, letters, numbers, words, brands, logos, screens, phone frames, charts, health dashboards or UI anywhere.
Art direction: elegant tactile still life photographed in a white studio; same family as a refined miniature architectural diorama in matte porcelain and warm paper, with frosted mint acrylic and deep forest-green accents. Brand palette: white #FFFFFF, warm ivory #F6F8F2, deep green #153F35, mint #91DDB6, restrained warm clay. Calm bright daylight, soft realistic shadows, premium product design magazine quality, quiet luxury and crisp refined detail. No cartoon gloss, no Apple logo or medical claims.
Subject: an open small ivory PAPER journal resting diagonally, clearly a physical book with blank gently curled paper pages, one forest-green pencil lying beside it. A delicate mint ribbon journey winds around the book and links three sculptural objects: one minimal deep-green location pin, one small pale mint HEART object representing context, and one cream crescent moon resting on a soft mint disc representing sleep. Include a single pair of tiny cream walking shoes near the ribbon to evoke everyday steps. These are physical symbolic sculptures, not buttons or app cards. The note pages are blank, no fake handwriting or metrics. No real person, precise location, account or health data.
Composition: the open journal is the central hero, location pin is on the upper right, heart and moon are balanced to the left and lower right, ribbon visually connects the objects without clutter. The whole still life fully visible, with generous pure white space all around, objects occupy about 80% of square. Elevated three-quarter camera, soft clean white seamless background, nothing cut off. Make a beautiful original final illustration with no surrounding copy or labels.
